response.overview: Still grieving the loss of her partner, Gertrud spends her days tending to a struggling flower stand, trapped in a monotonous routine. When Esther, an eccentric elderly woman with a love for games and an infectious zest for life, begins visiting the stand, their playful encounters slowly pull Gertrud out of her isolation. Through a series of increasingly absurd wagers, Esther challenges Gertrud to rediscover the joy, spontaneity, and human connection she has lost. Phase 10 is a bittersweet comedy about grief, unlikely friendship, and learning to dance again.
response.tagline: Phase 10 depicts the formation of a special connection between two unlikely characters that renews a unique love for life.
response.title: Phase 10
